1980 EXPLANATORY NOTE

The testina and performance of constant speed and variable was earlie; covered by the following Indian Standards: IS : 1600-1960 ` Code for type testing general purposes `, IS : 1601-1960 ` Performance purposes `, of constant speed speed internal internal

of constant

IS: 1602-1960 ` Code. for type testing of variable speed internal automotive purposes `, and IS : 1603-1960 ` Performance of variable-speed internal-combustion purposes `.

combustion engines for

engines

automotive

These standards were originally issued in the year 1960 and as a result of implementation of these standards by the manufacturers of engines and testing laboratories, as also the operation of ISI Certification Marking Scheme, these standards have now been extensively revised. While IS: 1600 and IS : 1602 covered the codes for type testing of constant and variable speed engines respectively, the performance requirements of such engines were covered by IS : 1601 and IS: 1603, respectively. These standards are now replaced by two sets of standards, one set covers the methods of testing of engines and the other covers the specification and perform.ance requirements of both constant speed and variable speed engines. The standard covering methods of tests is being published in following a particular test method or information related to methods of tests ): Is:loooo Is:10000 ls:loooo Is:loooo Is:1oooo Is:lm Is:10000 Is:loaoo Part I Glossary Part II Standard of terms relating reference to test methods 12 parts (each part

The revised methods of tests covered by IS : 10000 ( Part I to Part XII ) have been aligned with the current international practices in `the field of I. C. engines. These parts are in general agreement with the following IS0 standards, issued by the International Organization for Standardization: a) IS0 3046/l-1975 Reciprocating internal combustion engines - Perfdrmance: Part I Standard reference conditions and .declarations of power, fuel consumption and lubricating oil consumption Reciprocating internal Test methods Reciprocating internal Test measurements Reciprocating internal combustion combustion combustion engines enginesengines Performance: Performance: Vocabulary . Part II Part III,

b) IS0 c) IS0 d) IS0

3046/U-1977 3046/ill-1979 2710-1978

This Part Ill of IS : 10000 is in general agreement `with IS0 3046/ill-1979. However, the calculated quantities and their limits of accuracies have been deleted. Also the definitions covered by IS0 3046/ill-1979 have been covered in IS : 10000 ( Part I) - 1980. Many of the parameters which are not applicable to the Indian conditions have not been included from IS0 3046~111-1979, while some additional parameters like smoke levels have been introduced. IS : 10000 ( Part I to Part XII ) and IS : 10001, IS : 10002, IS : 10003 and IS : 10004 collectively supersede IS : 1600, IS : 1601, IS : 1602 and IS : 1603.
